none: PAS NLM-74A6EF: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constantine II (317-340), probably aCaesarum Nostrorum issue of 321-324, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Youthful bust diademed left, draped and possibly cuirassed. Obverse inscription: probably CONSTANTINVS NOB CAES. Reverse description: Wreath enclosing vow: probably VOT / X. Reverse inscription: [CAESARVM NOSTRORVM]. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight:…
